first_lines: Changes Made to The Dependency Stack For Ardour
The information below is generated from the build scripts we use to build all of the dependencies that Ardour requires.

issues: Build has not completed successfully since the latest build attempt
MinGW-w64 host toolchain is prepared via shared headless Ubuntu container; Windows-target .pc libraries must be provisioned under Dependencies/Windows-x64.
Waf Windows x64 configure, build and installer integration pending implementation.

algorithm: select a verified existing GCC10/MSVCRT installation or compatible pinned package
read the selected package dependency metadata, including version constraints and optional runtime dependencies
recursively add each newly discovered dependency to dependencies and repeat until fixed point
when no compatible binary is available, build from upstream source with required Ardour patches and record source hash and build flags
validate all selected artifacts and runtime imports against GCC10 POSIX MSVCRT
emit reproducible package lock with exact versions, URLs, hashes, and recursive edges
reject completion if any dependency is unresolved or a runtime DLL is missing

candidate_graph.evidence: provisional; not verified binary package metadata

proton_runtime_closure_test.provider: CinterForgeOS installed Proton (Wine Windows API implementation)
proton_runtime_closure_test.version_source: query installed CinterForgeOS Proton runtime at test time; never assume a fixed version

static_validation.targets: recursively inspect every staged PE executable and bundled DLL
check: required imported symbols or ordinals against selected Proton version

dynamic_validation.environment: CinterForgeOS with selected installed Proton runtime
check: runtime-loaded DLLs not visible in static PE imports

constraints: do not link against Proton or Wine internals
do not copy Proton DLLs into application
Windows application must remain independently runnable on native Windows
do not claim Proton closure verified until inspected and tested against installed runtime
proton_runtime_closure_test.failure_policy: report missing DLLs/exports with provider and Proton version; fail runtime closure test without altering GCC10/MSVCRT build dependency closure

proton_runtime_completion_gate.condition: all PE imports resolve via bundled DLLs or selected installed Proton runtime, and CinterForgeOS launch/smoke tests pass

upstream_build_tools.authority: Pinned Ardour Windows cross-dependency versions, sources, patches and build order

splash_code.note: Runtime splash; inspect small splash separately
